run_ids_comment: A curated set: ten slots and two edge cases (the layout is in `slots` and `edge_cases`), not twenty runs.
`run_ids` lists the runs that exist for filled slots and edge cases. Filled by tools/judging_json.py from the result records in S3.
Pending slots name what they wait for. Runs a slot compares against (`bar_run_id`, `base_run_id`) and every other run are under `supporting_run_ids`.
`python tools/judging_json.py --slots-report` prints which slots are filled and checks them against `run_ids`.

slots.name: swarm incident eval: masked-tier gain over config_revert
slots.bar: the bar is config_revert on the masked tier: gain over no_action 0.468, ci_low 0.167
slots.note: Scored on the live proposal-only swarm run t3.swarm-live-20261103T060140Z (54 cases, 23 proposals): gain over config_revert on the masked tier +0.296, 95% CI [0.034, 0.578] over 18 incidents, so the lower bound +0.034 passes the target (> 0). Not a large margin. Secondary, reported only: gain over the SDK rule baseline +0.196, CI [-0.04, 0.43], not significant; over no_action +0.764, CI [0.60, 0.91]; success 13 of 18; 64 cell-level actions on cells the fault did not touch. check_unit parts a, b, c and e pass.
